## Azure Arc-enabled System Center Virtual Machine Manager  
  
<!--07670c83-0a24-489a-bc7c-9378b9c8b2d2_begin-->

#### Migrate from Azure Arc-enabled SCVMM to recommended alternative solution  
  
Azure Arc-enabled System Center Virtual Machine Manager (SCVMM) is retiring. Follow the migration guidance to remove your SCVMM environment from Azure Arc and move to an alternative solution.  
  
**Potential benefits**: Avoid disruption from Azure Arc-enabled SCVMM retirement.  

**Impact:** Medium
  
For more information, see [Azure updates](https://azure.microsoft.com/updates/?id=570283)  

ResourceType: microsoft.scvmm/virtualmachinetemplates  
Recommendation ID: 07670c83-0a24-489a-bc7c-9378b9c8b2d2
